$comment: Acceptance figures on the reference image, machine-readable. ValidationTests (trait Category=Validation, not in the gate, ADR 0004) reads this file; docs/validation.md explains each case and records every change. One kind, analysis: AnalysisRun.Execute on the image with the case's parameters (aspect, distanceM, dmax, medium, targetBg; absent = the core's default). image is a manifest name under AstroPhotoAnalyzer.Tests/testdata/large/. expected lists the figures the case guards, by the names ValidationTests prints; tolerance applies to every numeric field that is not an integer; integers, booleans and strings are compared exactly; null means unmeasured. Change a figure here only after re-measuring and recording why in validation.md.
